content.text: /ext:medcp Pick a typical aromatase inhibitor and show how many breast-cancer patients received it.
I'll pick anastrozole (a typical aromatase inhibitor) and query the EHR database. Let me first see what tables are available.

This is a standard OMOP CDM. I'll count distinct breast-cancer patients who received anastrozole, joining drug exposures (mapped via `concept_ancestor` to the anastrozole ingredient) with a breast-cancer condition.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS breast_cancer_patients_on_anastrozole
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept ing
  ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ing.concept_id
 AND ing.concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
 AND LOWER(ing.concept_name) = 'anastrozole'
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON co.person_id = de.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor cca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = cca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE cca.ancestor_concept_id = 4112853;  -- Malignant tumor of breast

content.text:
**Anastrozole** (a typical aromatase inhibitor): **4,433** distinct breast-cancer patients received it in this OMOP database.

The count reflects patients with both (a) an anastrozole exposure (any descendant of the anastrozole ingredient) and (b) a diagnosis under "Malignant tumor of breast."
